name: Fuji Masami
source:
Vice President of the PTA.

She is a very devoted educational mother. Famous for being fussy even among teachers.

She is a married woman in her prime.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/teacher/chara.html]official site[/url]]
